name: Stanford CARE Explorers: AI x Precision Health
org: Stanford Center for Asian Health Research and Education
what_you_do: This is a two-week summer program, in person or online. It covers health topics that affect Asian communities. You learn AI basics and leadership skills. You also learn about precision health data.
who_can_apply: Rising sophomores, juniors and seniors who are at least 14. In-person students must live within commuting distance of the Palo Alto campus with a parent or guardian. You need a computer.
pay_detail: In-person fee $5,725. Online fee $3,500. Application fee $59. Limited need-based aid.
duration: 2 weeks (2027 sessions: June 14 to 25 and July 19 to 30 in person; July 6 to 16 online)
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open Nov 3, 2026. No closing date is posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CARE page when applications open Nov 3, 2026. You can sign up there for announcements. Questions: carehighschoolprogram@stanford.edu.
notes: Pay-to-play. In-person days run 9am to 3pm on weekdays, with lunch and snacks. No housing or rides. Online classes run 8:30am to 1pm Pacific on weekdays. Aid is for U.S. citizens and permanent residents who live and go to high school in the U.S.
